story_plan.thesis: Use the September 2026 first-release labor report to test how much a weak payroll increase says about labor demand when unemployment, wages, hours and participation are read together. This is a dated retrospective of information published October 2, not fresh news, a forecast or a position call.

photo_plan.subject: Authentic U.S. workplace or workers in an economically relevant setting, preferably a documented federal-government original photograph with individual creator and public-domain provenance.
photo_plan.discovery_owner: Existing media discovery and admission owner; inspect the retained lawful library first, then bounded free discovery if needed. SOURCE_1 through SOURCE_4 license factual data and do not themselves license photographs.
binding_requirements: Exact original file and source page, photographer/agency, individual license or public-domain statement, capture date if known, retrieval date, original-byte hash, caption, alt text and reuse conditions.
Caption an older or generic workplace image as contextual or archival; never imply it depicts September employment conditions or corroborates payroll measurements.
Use the actual media record for canonical attribution; do not infer photo rights from a .gov host, data rights or an agency logo.
Inspect the selected original through the existing admitted-image owner before assembly; MAX chooses relevance and placement. No native desktop automation is requested.
photo_plan.fallback: Use the admitted charts and source-bound facts card while the existing owner resolves an available lawful relevant photograph; never invent an image, license or credit.

chart_plan.editorial_status: Light proposes these four distinct charts; MAX decides final forms, count and placement before text approval.
common_rules: Use exact admitted source values and clocks. History is a stitched sequence of first-reference-month prints from dated BLS releases, not a single revised time series as of October 2.

Reference window October 2024 through September 2026; economic information cutoff October 2, 2026 at 12:30 UTC for this retrospective, within the operation cutoff November 4, 2026 at 04:37:23.779989 UTC. Retrieval on October 30 does not establish possession at each historical release.

Preserve observed versus derived status, published rounding, seasonal adjustment, source identity, series and transformations. No interpolation, missing-to-zero conversion, annualization or later revisions.
Use original data graphics, readable units and separate axes or panels for different units; no dual-axis suggestion that unlike measures are directly comparable.
Code owns extraction, arithmetic, scaling and validation; actual values and transformations must remain traceable to admitted source records and hashes.

charts.purpose: Put the latest weak hiring print in its two-year first-release context.
charts.proposed_form: Monthly columns with zero baseline; highlight September 2026, retaining negative months.
charts.metric: Seasonally adjusted monthly change in total nonfarm payroll employment
charts.unit: Thousands of persons; deterministic conversion from admitted persons divided by 1000
charts.latest_change: Display September's admitted monthly change directly; do not difference an already differenced series.
charts.vintage_caption: BLS initial monthly payroll estimates, first prints from each dated release; historical values have not been replaced with later revisions.

charts.purpose: Show the household-survey measure alongside payroll hiring without treating the surveys as interchangeable.
charts.proposed_form: Single line with a visible break at missing October 2025; highlight September 2026.
charts.missingness: October 2025 is null, NOT_PUBLISHED_OR_NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_EVENT; preserve the gap and do not connect across it or imply 24 observed values.
charts.latest_change: Latest level from the source; calculate any month-to-month difference only from admitted adjacent observations, in percentage points.
charts.placement_proposal: At the distinction between establishment and household evidence

charts.purpose: Test wage momentum separately from the payroll count.
charts.proposed_form: Monthly columns or dots for average hourly earnings monthly percentage changes, zero baseline.
charts.metric: Seasonally adjusted monthly percentage change in average hourly earnings of all private nonfarm employees
charts.derived_point: July 2026 is DERIVED_FROM_FIRST_RELEASE_LEVELS_NOT_EXPLICIT_PERCENT. Retain that status and supplied HALF_UP_TO_ONE_DECIMAL rule; distinguish it in the chart note rather than calling every point an explicitly published rate.
charts.latest_change: Use the admitted September monthly rate. Do not infer annual inflation-adjusted wages from this nominal series.
charts.placement_proposal: Within the wages and hours mechanism section

charts.purpose: Identify which industries added or lost jobs in the same September first release and whether gains were concentrated.
charts.proposed_form: Diverging horizontal bars for mutually exclusive broad industry monthly payroll changes; total nonfarm shown separately as reference.
charts.source_resolution: Existing CC-010 archive owner extracts seasonally adjusted September versus August industry changes from Table B-1 of the October 2 release, using both levels from that same dated table or explicitly printed monthly changes. Bind resulting admitted numeric source rows before MAX writes sector claims.
charts.unit: Thousands of persons, seasonally adjusted monthly change
charts.validation: Use exhaustive mutually exclusive broad industry rows where available; never sum parent and child industries together. Reconcile the sum to total nonfarm within published rounding and preserve residuals explicitly. Do not substitute first-print August levels from SOURCE_2 for the August level printed in this release.
charts.values: Not yet extracted into this packet; no sector values are invented.
